subject: general
question: In which year did the Government of India institute two civilian awards - Bharat Ratna and Padma Vibhushan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1954.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Government of India instituted two civilian awards**-Bharat Ratna & Padma Vibhushan** in **1954**.
 
• The latter had three classes that are** Pahela Varg, Dusra Varg, and Tisra Varg.**
 
• These were later renamed **Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan and Padma Shri** vide Presidential Notification issued on **January 8, 1955.**
 
• The **first receiver** of the Padma Vibhushan was **Satyendra Nath Bose, Nandalal Bose, Zakir Husain, Balasaheb Gangadhar Kher, V. K. Krishna Menon, and Jigme Dorji Wangchuck**, who was honored in 1954.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Bharat Ratna is the highest civilian award of the self government of India.
 
• The Padma Vibhushan ("Lotus Decoration") is the second-highest civilian award of the self government of India, following the Bharat Ratna.
 
• ​**Padma Shri** is the** fourth-highest civilian award of the self government of India.**
